core_capabilities: Create, rename, and delete boards used to organize a project.
Create, rename, reorder, and remove lists to represent stages of work.
Create, edit, move, reorder, and delete cards as work progresses across lists.
Document and categorize card work using rich descriptions and labels.
Invite collaborators to a board and assign or unassign them from cards.
secondary_capabilities: Personalize a board by selecting an image background.

app.description: A collaborative Kanban board application for organizing work into boards, lists, and cards.
